corpus: corpus/objective-02: the twenty indexed documents D01-D20
manifest: corpus/objective-02/manifest.json supplies each document's reference department and its Project, Process and Topic tags; this file supplies only the document type
notes: The type was decided from each document's own text, and `evidence` quotes it.
`fit` is strong, fair or weak: weak means none of the four types fits well and `alternative` names the next-best. Four are weak: D07, D09, D13, D20.
The 75% match rate is computed over all twenty suggested types, provisional or not. Department is reported beside it but is not part of the 75%. Tags are reported for information only.
